description_en: Queries information about instances of a manually triggered workflow
description_zh: 调用GetManualDagInstances，获取手动执行的业务流程实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-manual-dag-instances --project-env RPOD --project-name test_workspace --dag-id 7000001231241 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetManualDagInstances

parameters.help_en: The environment identifier of the Operation Center. Valid values: PROD (production environment) and DEV (development environment)
parameters.help_zh: 运维中心的调度环境标识，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the manual workflow belongs. You can obtain the name on the workspace configuration page in the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间名称。您可以进入DataWorks管控台，在工作空间配置页面获取
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the DAG instance that triggers the manual workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发手动业务流程运行的Dag实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189728.html接口获取
parameters.name: dag_id

Instances.description_en: The list of internal instances of the manual workflow
Instances.description_zh: 手动业务流程的内部实例列表

BeginRunningTime.description_en:
The time when the instance node started to run.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
BeginRunningTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始运行的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BeginWaitResTime.description_en:
The time when the instance node started to wait for resources.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
BeginWaitResTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始等待资源的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BeginWaitTimeTime.description_en:
The time when the instance node started to wait for scheduling.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
BeginWaitTimeTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始等待调度的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BizDate.description_en:
The business date. This is typically the day before the node runs.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
BizDate.description_zh:
业务日期。通常为该任务运行时间的前一天。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the instance node was created.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例任务的创建时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

CycTime.description_en:
The scheduled time of the instance node.

The value is a 13-digit number, for example, `1605178414676`
CycTime.description_zh:
实例任务的定时时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

DagId.description_en: The DAG ID of the manual workflow instance

DagType.description_en: The type of the manual workflow

FinishTime.description_en:
The time when the instance node finished running.

FinishTime.description_zh:
实例任务运行的结束时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

The most recent modification time of the instance node.

ModifyTime.description_zh:
实例任务最新的修改时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

NodeId.description_en: The internal node ID of the workflow

ParamValues.description_en: The parameter information of the instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance node. Valid values:
NOT_RUN: The instance is not run.
WAIT_TIME: The instance is waiting for the scheduled dueTime or cycleTime.
WAIT_RESOURCE: The instance is waiting for resources.
RUNNING: The instance is running.
CHECKING: The instance is submitted to Data Quality for data verification.
CHECKING_CONDITION: The instance is performing branch condition verification.
FAILURE: The instance failed to run.
SUCCESS: The instance is run successfully
Status.description_zh:
实例任务的状态，取值如下：
NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待定时时间dueTime或cycleTime到来）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（下发给数据质量进行数据校检）
CHECKING_CONDITION（正在进行分支条件校检）
FAILURE（执行失败）
SUCCESS（执行成功）

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the instance node. Valid values:
NORMAL(0): a normal scheduling node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis.
MANUAL(1): a manual node. The node is not scheduled on a daily basis.
PAUSE(2): a paused node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but is set to failed when scheduling starts.
SKIP(3): a dry-run node. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but is set to successful when scheduling starts.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): a node that is not selected in a temporary workflow. This type of node exists only in temporary workflows and is set to successful when scheduling starts.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): a weekly or monthly node that has not reached its run cycle. The node is scheduled on a daily basis, but is set to successful when scheduling starts.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): a downstream node that is not selected by an upstream branch (IF) node. The node is directly set to dry-run.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): an expired periodic instance generated in real time. This type of node is directly set to successful
TaskType.description_zh:
实例任务的调度类型，取值如下：
NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：暂停任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
